selected_evidence.requirement: CA created and installed as trusted system CA (healthy baseline of the work itself)
selected_evidence.summary: CA cert generated, copied to trust anchors, update-ca-trust extract run; trust list, bundle grep, and openssl verify all confirm it is trusted.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: First poll hit connection reset (node down); second poll succeeded with new boot_id af9fe17c-bd00-4b49-9b56-d66422933f8e, differing from baseline.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required state (CA trust persistence)
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, trust list still shows OS Comparison Root CA as an anchor, ca-bundle.crt still contains it, and openssl verify still succeeds — confirming the trust configuration survived the restart.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: prepare CA directory"
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/os-comparison-root-ca
cd /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/os-comparison-root-ca

echo "STEP: generate CA private key"
sudo -n openssl genrsa -out ca.key 4096 2>/dev/null

echo "STEP: generate self-signed CA certificate"
sudo -n openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key ca.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA/O=OS Comparison Lab" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out ca.crt

sudo -n chmod 600 ca.key
sudo -n chmod 644 ca.crt

echo "STEP: install CA cert into system trust anchors"
sudo -n cp ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo -n update-ca-trust extract

echo "STEP: verify CA cert details"
openssl x509 -in ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates

echo "STEP: verify trust installation via p11-kit/trust list"
trust list | grep -A2 "OS Comparison Root CA" || true

echo "STEP: verify openssl trusted CA bundle contains it"
awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /OS Comparison Root CA/{c++} END{print "bundle-matches="c}' /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt

echo "STEP: verify cert validates against system trust store"
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt ca.crt
commands.stdout:

    label: OS Comparison Root CA
    trust: anchor
    category: authority
STEP: verify openssl trusted CA bundle contains it

STEP: verify cert validates against system trust store

commands.command:

echo "== trust list check =="
